headline: Maui Liquor Commission

meeting.summary: The Liquor Control Commission accepted a brewery's application pending zoning, and the department director announced his December 31 retirement.
meeting.recap: The Liquor Control Commission met on Wednesday, September 9.[[0:00:30]] The commission accepted a liquor license application for the Maui Beach Ballroom.[[0:18:49]] Staff said zoning may not let a brewery pub applicant sell beer directly to wholesalers, restaurants or stores.[[0:37:06]] A motion to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) about county liability failed, four to three.[[1:04:28]] The commission accepted the brewery's application, which must still meet all license requirements, including zoning.[[1:06:59]] The commission approved a wholesale liquor license for Island Distributing LLC.[[1:11:23]] The department director said he will retire, with December 31 as his last day.[[1:37:11]] A special meeting is set for September 21 at 1:30 p.m. to discuss how to find a new director.[[1:40:09]] The department said nonprofits may auction a wine country trip, but not a restaurant gift certificate that includes liquor.[[1:54:30]] The commission approved an updated application form for special liquor licenses.[[1:57:12]] The commission renewed, for the seventh time, an emergency rule on relocating liquor licenses from premises destroyed in the August 2023 wildfires.[[2:00:03]] Commissioners agreed to pause new rule changes while the department updates a full rewrite of the liquor rules.[[2:22:20]] The commission voted to go into executive session.[[2:55:13]]
decided: The commission approved the day's agenda.
The commission approved the minutes of its August 12, 2026 meeting.
The commission confirmed the department's general licensing actions.
The commission accepted the Maui Beach Ballroom application while the applicant finishes remaining requirements.
The commission accepted the Aloha Spirits Brewing and Distilling application, with zoning among the requirements still to be met.
The commission approved a wholesale general liquor license for Island Distributing LLC.
The commission approved application number 18 for Mokai Dignity LLC.
The commission approved the updated special liquor license application form, DLC 016.
The commission approved the seventh reauthorization of the emergency rule for premises destroyed in the August 2023 wildfires.
The commission voted to go into executive session.
meeting.next: The department is waiting for the planning department to confirm in writing what the brewery may do at its location. Staff will seek written confirmation on whether a nonprofit tax form can be used as proof of nonprofit status. An updated draft of the full rules rewrite will be back on next month's agenda. The department will ask corporation counsel (the county's lawyers) for advice on signature and notarization rules.
